summary: Rocco fetches Norin so repeated exile-return enters ping the table, draw cards, and feed Aura Shards.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Norin the Wary and Saltskitter exile themselves and return every turn cycle; the whole 99 is built to fire on those repeated enters.

tags.name: burn
tags.reason: Impact Tremors, Witty Roastmaster, Molten Gatekeeper, Agate Instigator, Arbaaz Mir, Outpost Siege, and Torbran turn each enter into table-wide damage as the primary clock.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Genesis Chamber, Blessed Sanctuary, Saradoc, Gala Greeters, and Samwise make creatures and Foods off the same enters that grow Champion of Lambholt.

tags.name: go-wide
tags.reason: Token producers plus Champion of Lambholt and End-Raze Forerunners are the combat backup when pings are slow.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Tocasia's Welcome, Welcoming Vampire, Enduring Innocence, Mentor of the Meek, Rumor Gatherer, and Soul of the Harvest convert ETBs into cards.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Green dorks, Reach/Cultivate, Talismans, and bounce lands support a three-color commander; ramp is setup, not the plan.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Confusion in the Ranks exchanges permanents on every enter, a real package of one card rather than the deck's identity.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Soul Warden, Essence Warden, Gala Greeters, and Blessed Sanctuary cushion ping wars; they are not a lifegain win.

tags.name: legends
tags.reason: Gandalf, Gimli, Legolas, Saradoc, Samwise, and Arbaaz pay off legendary enters, but the deck is not a legends tribal list.

tags.name: food
tags.reason: Samwise Gamgee makes Foods for life and historic recursion, a single card.

tags.name: treasure
tags.reason: Gala Greeters, Rose Room Treasurer, and Gimli make incidental Treasure.

tags.name: halflings
tags.reason: Saradoc and Samwise are Halfling payoffs without a tribe package.
